title: 鐵電記憶體氧化鉿薄膜
titleEn: Hafnia thin films for ferroelectric memory
summary: 從晶相與鐵電性、摻雜與比例到整合證據：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Phase and ferroelectricity and Dopants and composition to Integration evidence: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 晶相與鐵電性 → PUND 差分
stages.titleEn: Phase and ferroelectricity to PUND differencing
stages.description: 把「晶相與鐵電性」「極化迴圈」「PUND 差分」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Phase and ferroelectricity, Polarization loops, PUND differencing.

steps.title: 晶相與鐵電性：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Phase and ferroelectricity: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase.
steps.instruction: 對單斜、四方及正交相畫分類表，分開結構證據與電性證據。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Classify monoclinic, tetragonal and orthorhombic phases with structural/electrical evidence. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相；X 光相峰重疊可能使相判讀不唯一。
steps.observationEn: The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase; Overlapping diffraction peaks can obscure phase identity.
steps.failure: 若採用「只量化學成分就宣稱鐵電性」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Claiming ferroelectricity from composition alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「晶相與鐵電性」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Phase and ferroelectricity diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase.

knowledge.title: 晶相與鐵電性／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Phase and ferroelectricity / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 機制：氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase.

knowledge.title: 晶相與鐵電性／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Phase and ferroelectricity / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只量化學成分就宣稱鐵電性」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Claiming ferroelectricity from composition alone.

quiz.question: 關於「晶相與鐵電性」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Phase and ferroelectricity, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相
只量化學成分就宣稱鐵電性
任何封閉 I-V 積分迴圈都當鐵電證明
optionsEn: The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase
Treating every closed integrated loop as ferroelectric proof
quiz.explanation: 氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 晶相與鐵電性：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Phase and ferroelectricity: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只量化學成分就宣稱鐵電性」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Claiming ferroelectricity from composition alone.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「晶相與鐵電性」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只量化學成分就宣稱鐵電性」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：X 光相峰重疊可能使相判讀不唯一。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Phase and ferroelectricity artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Claiming ferroelectricity from composition alone". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Overlapping diffraction peaks can obscure phase identity. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相；X 光相峰重疊可能使相判讀不唯一。
steps.observationEn: The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase; Overlapping diffraction peaks can obscure phase identity.
steps.failure: 若採用「只量化學成分就宣稱鐵電性」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Claiming ferroelectricity from composition alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「晶相與鐵電性」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「X 光相峰重疊可能使相判讀不唯一」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Phase and ferroelectricity, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Overlapping diffraction peaks can obscure phase identity" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 晶相與鐵電性／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Phase and ferroelectricity / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：X 光相峰重疊可能使相判讀不唯一。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Overlapping diffraction peaks can obscure phase identity.

knowledge.title: 晶相與鐵電性／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Phase and ferroelectricity / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「只量化學成分就宣稱鐵電性」與「氧化鉿存在不等於已形成鐵電相」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Claiming ferroelectricity from composition alone" is not equivalent to "The presence of hafnia does not establish a ferroelectric phase"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.observationEn: Leakage can make charge loops resemble ferroelectric hysteresis; Series impedance can distort loops.
